{"id":1517921219,"question_id":26,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 6 months","timestamp":1737634261,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1517921219/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array","memory":"22.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int removeDuplicates(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int i=1,j=0;\n        while(i<nums.size()){\n            if(nums[i]==nums[j])\n            ++i;\n            else\n            {\n                nums[++j]=nums[i++];\n            }\n        }\n        return j+1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"remove-duplicates-from-sorted-array","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":242}
